entries.title: Frontend search results page.
entries.notes: Captured from the package-owned themed results fixture; the light/dark outputs contain indexed ranked results inside the real frontend shell.
entries.useCase: A visitor searches seeded public content and sees ranked results and pagination.

entries.title: Header search field.
entries.notes: Public workbench host mounts the real Search header dialog and real search results for a seeded discoverable page. Open the header control and require its search input plus populated results.
entries.useCase: A visitor uses the header search control supplied by the package frontend surface.

entries.title: Top searches widget.
entries.notes: Authenticated widget-only fixture renders the actual Search Livewire table with deterministic query logs. Require its own populated table, not the Insights dashboard.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews top searched terms from seeded query logs.

entries.title: Trending searches widget.
entries.notes: Authenticated widget-only fixture renders the actual Search Livewire table with deterministic query logs. Require its own populated table, not the Insights dashboard.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews trending searches over the configured window.

entries.title: Zero-result searches widget.
entries.notes: Authenticated widget-only fixture renders the actual Search Livewire table with deterministic query logs. Require its own populated table, not the Insights dashboard.
entries.useCase: An administrator identifies search terms with no matching content.

entries.title: Site search settings screen.
entries.notes: Search settings are a package management slide-over on Extensions. The retired standalone settings path is not registered.
entries.useCase: A site owner configures search settings, logging, retention, and result behavior.

entries.title: Illustrative annotated search curation settings preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic catalogue fixture, not a live package UI capture. Annotated marketplace explainer derived from the Search settings surface to show synonyms, typo corrections, and promoted results.
entries.useCase: A site owner understands how Search curation controls query intent and promoted answers.
